summary: Comprehensive testing of Digital Twin MVP with 27 sensors, PFD visualization, and analytics features completed successfully. All major functionality working as expected.
passed_tests: Backend API returns exactly 27 sensors with correct distribution (5 FIT, 10 LIT, 5 PIT, 2 pH, 1 Cl, 2 EC, 2 DPT)
PFD shows labeled instrument tags (LIT, FIT, PIT, pH/ORP, Cl, EC, DPT) placed on tank/meter positions
Legend displays type color coding (LIT=blue, FIT=blue, PIT=orange, pH/Cl=green, EC=purple) and status colors
Clicking LIT_MR tag opens analytics for Main Reservoir Level
Clicking PIT_RACF1 tag opens analytics for RACF 1 Pressure
Clicking FIT_10 tag opens analytics for Main Feed Flow
Clicking pH_RO tag opens analytics for RO Break Tank pH
Clicking EC_NANO tag opens analytics for Nano Filtration EC
Back to PFD button returns to main view with all tags visible
Hover effects work on instrument tags with scaling and highlighting
Tooltips show instrument details and 'Click to view analytics' hint
6 leak indicators display correctly on PFD with leak detection badge
Metric cards show updated values - Total Flow ~500 L/min, Sensors Online 26/27 format
Date range selector works (1H, 6H, 24H, 7D, ALL buttons functional)
CSV and PDF export buttons present and clickable in analytics view
Statistics cards display current, mean, min, max, and std dev values
Time series charts with rolling averages display correctly
AI agent integration working with Claude Sonnet 4.5
System stats API returns correct sensor count (27 total sensors)
Analytics API works for all tested instruments with time range filtering
Leak detection endpoints return active leaks and zone information
Compliance reports generate correctly for different time ranges

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (All PFD interactions, analytics, and UI elements working)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (All tag clicks open correct analytics, navigation works)
